@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+{
+  "version": "0.2.0",
+  "configurations": [
+    {
+      "name": "Run Ruby Lexer Benchmark (Terminal)",
+      "type": "pwa-node",
+      "request": "launch",
+      "program": "${workspaceFolder}/specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/bench/run_lexer_bench.rb",
+      "console": "integratedTerminal",
+      "internalConsoleOptions": "neverOpen"
+    },
+    {
+      "name": "Run Parser (script)",
+      "type": "pwa-node",
+      "request": "launch",
+      "program": "${workspaceFolder}/specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/parser-prototype/ruby/parser.rb",
+      "args": [
+        "${workspaceFolder}/specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/corpus/sample.minilang"
+      ],
+      "console": "integratedTerminal",
+      "internalConsoleOptions": "neverOpen"
+    }
+  ]
+}
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+{
+    "chat.promptFilesRecommendations": {
+        "speckit.constitution": true,
+        "speckit.specify": true,
+        "speckit.plan": true,
+        "speckit.tasks": true,
+        "speckit.implement": true
+    },
+    "chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove": {
+        ".specify/scripts/bash/": true,
+        ".specify/scripts/powershell/": true
+    },
+    "terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux": "fish",
+    "editor.formatOnSave": false,
+    "files.associations": {
+        "*.wg": "ini",
+        "*.minilang": "plaintext"
+    },
+    "yaml.format.enable": true
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+{
+  "version": "2.0.0",
+  "tasks": [
+    {
+      "label": "Run Ruby prototypes (tests)",
+      "type": "shell",
+      "command": "rspec --format documentation specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/lexer-prototype/ruby/spec/lexer_spec.rb specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/parser-prototype/ruby/spec/parser_spec.rb",
+      "presentation": {
+        "reveal": "always",
+        "panel": "shared"
+      },
+      "group": "test",
+      "problemMatcher": []
+    },
+    {
+      "label": "Run Ruby lexer benchmark",
+      "type": "shell",
+      "command": "ruby specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/bench/run_lexer_bench.rb",
+      "presentation": {
+        "reveal": "always",
+        "panel": "shared"
+      },
+      "group": "none",
+      "problemMatcher": []
+    },
+    {
+      "label": "Run Parser (example)",
+      "type": "shell",
+      "command": "ruby specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/parser-prototype/ruby/parser.rb specs/001-wiregram-framework/research/corpus/sample.minilang",
+      "presentation": {
+        "reveal": "always",
+        "panel": "shared"
+      },
+      "group": "none",
+      "problemMatcher": []
+    }
+  ]
+}
